cohiba-dr--cohiba-red-dot.description: The original General Cigar Cohiba, introduced for the American market in the late 1990s and made at General Cigar Dominicana, wraps Dominican Piloto Cubano filler and an Indonesian Jember binder in triple-fermented Cameroon. Medium and smooth, it shows cedar and cream with cinnamon, honey, leather and coffee.

thirds.notes: Cedar and sweet cream with cinnamon and a subtle spice, smooth and easygoing.
Cedar stays in front, joined by roasted nuts and soft leather as the creaminess builds.
Earth, roasted coffee and toasted wood take over as the cream fades, with a little more pepper and a raisin sweetness.

sources.title: After Action Cigars – Cohiba Red Dot review

cohiba-dr--cohiba-black.description: Introduced in 2006, Cohiba Black is made in the Dominican Republic with a Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper, a Dominican binder and Dominican Piloto Cubano and Mexican filler rested for three years in palm-bark tercios. Creamy and sweet, it shows cocoa, espresso and cedar with leather and earth.

cohiba-dr--cohiba-blue.description: Launched in 2017, Cohiba Blue uses Honduran Olancho San Agustín tobacco for wrapper and binder, around filler from Jamastran, Ometepe and Dominican Piloto Cubano. Lighter than the other Cohibas, it is a medium smoke of cedar, cocoa and a molasses-like sweetness with cinnamon and white pepper.

thirds.notes: Peppery leather and earth up front, herbal and floral notes on the retrohale and a salty finish.
Leather develops alongside roasted nuts, coffee and earth; the spice settles and the body fills out.
Pepper, earth and coffee dominate as the floral notes fade, with charred wood and a rising sweetness.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Cohiba Blue Robusto

cohiba-dr--cohiba-connecticut.description: Released in 2019 and made at General Cigar Dominicana, Cohiba Connecticut sets an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper over a San Andrés binder and filler of Brazilian Mata Fina, Dominican Piloto Cubano and Olor and Nicaraguan Jalapa. Mild to medium, it moves from cream, malt and toasted cedar into baking spice and coffee.

thirds.notes: Rich tobacco, cream and dry leather with a fairly bold pepper; caramel and cedar for other tasters.
The pepper retreats to cedar, baking spice and hay, with coffee and malt in the richest stretch.
Leather and cedar return with a building pepper, and a tea-and-lemon tang for some.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Cohiba Connecticut Robusto
Cigar Dojo – Cohiba Connecticut Robusto review

cohiba-dr--cohiba-nicaragua.description: Described as the first Nicaraguan Cohiba, this line uses a Nicaraguan Jalapa binder and long filler from Estelí and Jalapa under a sun-grown Honduran Colorado Oscuro wrapper. Full and intense, it brings leather and sweet cedar with black pepper and a caramel-like sweetness.

cohiba-dr--cohiba-riviera.description: Cohiba Riviera, launched in 2023 and made at STG Estelí in Nicaragua, wraps a Honduran-grown Connecticut binder and Honduran and Nicaraguan filler in a dark Mexican San Andrés leaf. Medium to full, it shows cocoa, coffee and cedar with earth, leather and baking spice, turning drier toward the end.

thirds.notes: Cinnamon and black pepper settle into a silky hot-chocolate profile, with dry cedar, earth and coffee.
Chocolate-covered raisin and a fermented maduro earthiness, with soil and grassy notes from the binder late on.
Lighter and drier, with more tannin, a little vanilla and a chewy nuttiness.

cohiba-dr--cohiba-royale.description: Cohiba Royale pairs a Nicaraguan broadleaf wrapper from the Jalapa Valley with a Dominican Piloto Cubano binder and Dominican, Honduran and Nicaraguan filler, its leaves aged around five to six years. It is a rich smoke of aged leather, bittersweet cocoa and earth, with cedar, sweet spice and a floral aroma.

cohiba-dr--cohiba-macassar.description: Made in the Dominican Republic, Cohiba Macassar uses a dark, oily Connecticut Habano wrapper finished in rum barrels, a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and Dominican and Nicaraguan filler aged at least four years. A rich, fuller-bodied cigar, it offers aromatic wood, leather, baking spice and espresso with a hint of black cherry.

cohiba-dr--cohiba-rubicon.description: Cohiba Rubicon, released in 2025 and made at HATSA in Danlí, Honduras, wraps Dominican Piloto Cubano, Honduran La Entrada and Jamastran and Nicaraguan Estelí filler in an Ecuadorian Habano leaf over a US Broadleaf binder. It starts creamy and builds gradually, through coffee, cocoa and nuts toward an earthier, spicier finish.

thirds.notes: Sweet and spicy, with honey and early black pepper, then tangy dried fruit and a light creaminess.
Mocha cream and mild cedar with cocoa and toast on the retrohale, and a touch of red berry and black tea.
Dark chocolate, espresso and cedar spice with roasted nuts to close, strength now a little above medium.

sources.title: Stogie Press – Cohiba Rubicon Robusto review

cohiba-dr--cohiba-serie-m.description: Cohiba Serie M is a 2021 limited edition rolled at El Titán de Bronze in Miami's Little Havana. A dark Nicaraguan Corojo wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. It smokes nutty and creamy, with cedar, leather and caramel, gaining pepper and a hint of espresso toward the end.

thirds.notes: Cashew-like nuttiness with cedar and black pepper and a touch of lemon, then almond, leather and a little caramel.
Smooth nuttiness, the spice softening to white pepper as caramel grows and the smoke turns creamy.
Clove and stone-fruit notes, returning pepper, a smoky char and a hint of espresso bitterness.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Cohiba Serie M

cohiba-dr--cohiba-spectre.description: Cohiba Spectre is a limited release from General Cigar Dominicana whose blend changes between editions. The 2019 version used a long-aged Nicaraguan Jalapa wrapper and Nicaraguan filler finished in sherry casks; the 2025 edition turned to a Havana-seed Connecticut wrapper from the 2017 harvest, a San Andrés binder and Dominican Criollo '98 from Mao.

cohiba-dr--weller-by-cohiba.description: Weller by Cohiba is a recurring limited collaboration with Weller bourbon; the 2022 edition was rolled at General Cigar Dominicana. An Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper covers a Broadleaf binder rested in used Weller barrels and filler from the Dominican Republic, Estelí and three Honduran regions. Oak, toasted nuts and vanilla lead, with caramel, coffee and a peppery finish.

sources.title: Regency Cigar – The new Weller by Cohiba
